about.heading: About
paragraphs: Senior frontend engineer with 8 years and 3 months of commercial experience, the last 4 years as a hands-on team lead who still writes production code every day. Core stack is Angular with TypeScript and RxJS, used continuously in every role since 2018; ReactJS and React Native as a second stack, Node.js with NestJS on the backend side.

Track record in B2B platforms and self-service portals: partner dashboards, administrative panels, data marketplaces and integrations with external systems, delivered for government and enterprise clients in Malaysia and for SaaS products across the CIS region. Four years based in Malaysia with a Malaysian company, including client-facing solution consulting in English.

Since 2025 I have run an AI-first engineering process end to end — shipping production systems built with agentic development tooling while keeping code review, manual testing and architectural standards mandatory. The guardrails are the point: a specification with explicit acceptance criteria before the work starts, and automated verification before it is called done.

items.role: Solution Consultant → Solution Architect & Frontend Team Lead
items.summary: Owned the frontend track across system-integration and BigData programmes for Malaysian government and enterprise clients. Grew from consultant to solution architect and development team lead, working directly with clients in English on requirements and technical documentation.
bullets: SSM Data Marketplace (Ministry of Domestic Trade) — an online marketplace for statistical data giving individuals and companies access to BigData through complex filtering at the Data Lake and Data Warehouse level. Designed and implemented the frontend architecture in ReactJS and TypeScript, and was the only backend developer on the project: a Java Spring Boot service and a Postgres schema from an empty repository.

Non-standard build on that project: bundles embedded into Apache Wicket through a custom bridge and served from a single Tomcat instance alongside Spring Boot, with no separate Node.js runtime in production.

Report Service — a standalone NestJS microservice abstracting Data Lake and Data Warehouse access: SQL assembled on the fly from client-side filters, source configurations stored as JSON, Redis caching. Designed, built and tested end to end.

JPJ AwAS (Road Transport Department) — automated penalty reporting from road cameras, integrated with a traffic-violation recognition system. Frontend in Angular and TypeScript on top of Java Spring Boot.
Contributed to system architecture design, technical documentation, requirement alignment with clients and task distribution across the development team.

items.location: Uzbekistan, project engagement alongside primary role
items.summary: Delivered an end-to-end freight logistics platform for the CIS market: a landing page, an administrative panel, a web workspace for logistics operators and dispatchers, and a driver mobile application — four applications to production in four months.
bullets: Admin panel in Angular 17, dispatcher workspace in ReactJS with TypeScript, driver application in React Native for iOS and Android, landing page in Astro, backend in NestJS with PostgreSQL.
Built AI-first from day one: implementation through agentic development tooling, screen and user-flow prototyping before code.

Introduced a parallel multi-agent development workflow using Git Submodules as a shared documentation layer — one consistent context space for every agent and every engineer on the team, which stopped parallel work from drifting apart on architectural decisions.
Responsible for client-side architecture, business logic design and task distribution across the team.
Outcome: platform live in production, mobile applications submitted for App Store and Google Play review.

items.summary: Single-window management system for hotels and hotel chains, covering bookings, reporting and dynamic pricing.
bullets: Core product capability was two-way integration with distribution channels: Booking.com, Agoda, Airbnb, Mybooking.uz and others.
Hands-on development in Angular 9 and above with TypeScript, client-side architecture decisions, code review and onboarding of new developers. Backend team worked in PHP.

items.summary: Web and mobile interface development in Angular 2 and above with TypeScript. Progressed from developer to team lead across several commercial projects.
bullets: E-Cinema — a three-product suite (E-Ticket, E-Kino, Kinoprokat) for cinema distribution management, electronic ticket sales and reporting automation. Role: project manager and frontend developer in Angular.
Falcon Messenger — a corporate messenger. Role: Android team lead and hands-on development in Kotlin, with AES and RSA encryption and Socket.IO.
